correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md at frozen blob 647eefb8... normalizes S_K=2πμ, Steiner center at 0, geodesic W1 on a length-2π circle. Published Green kernel (D²+1)^{-1} with first harmonics removed has 1/2 geodesic Lipschitz constant, giving d_H≤πW1 for balanced probabilities. The constructed μ_ε and ν each have unit mass and vanishing first moment; adding common uniform aσ makes both admissible nondegenerate. A four-site 1-Lipschitz dual potential proves the exact W1=ε/2+(1−cos ε)(π−ε)/[2(1+cos ε)], not merely an upper-cost coupling. Direct kernel evaluation gives support gap H=(π−ε)sin ε/(1+cos ε); H/W1→π. Convolution by a positive circular heat kernel preserves first moment, uniform lower curvature density, and the limiting ratio, proving smooth strict-convex sharpness. Independent direct numerical evaluations at ε=.3,.1,.02,.003 gave ratios 2.35383, 2.82868, 3.07372, 3.13122. The asymptotic proof is analytic; numerical values are finite checks.
